Team —

We have Olivia Chen (SWE II) for a 60-minute pairing/coding screen on Tue 10/20. I want to keep this lightweight and reproducible across panels, so I put together a short run-of-show and a recommended interviewer toolkit. See attachments: olivia_chen_resume.pdf and tech-run-of-show-v2.md.

Proposed flow (high level):
- 5m intro / role context (Markus)
- 45m live pair (CoderPad)
- 10m debrief + rubric (private thread)

Asks:
- Kimberly: can you own the pair (drive) and jump in at 1:05pm PT?
- Mina: would you shadow and take notes / rubric capture? If you can, please join the Meet as observer and I'll give you co-host rights so you can start the debrief doc.
- Priyom: please confirm candidate calendar and send the final links (Meet + CoderPad). Also confirm recording consent checkbox text.

I left a short checklist in the run-of-show for pre-call checks (audio, CoderPad perms, recording consent). If you want to tweak the problem or swap in a longer systems question, highlight it in the doc and I'll approve.

Thanks — aiming for a crisp execution so we can get feedback quickly.

Markus
